text: . Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla has paid tributes to Param Vir Chakra awardee Captain Vikram Batra on his birth anniversary today. In a social media post, Mr Birla said that Captain Vikram Batra made supreme sacrifice while defending the nation with unbreakable patriotic fervor and unparalleled valor on the icy peaks of Kargil. He added that Captain Vikram Batra’s bravery and courage will forever inspire generations to come.

. In Badminton, Indian men’s doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty will take on the Malaysian duo of Nur Mohd Azriyn Ayub and Tan Wee Kiong in the semi-final of the China Masters in Shenzhen today.The Indian pair defeated Denmark’s Kim Astrup and Anders Skaarup Rasmussen 21-13, 16-21, 21-18 in the quarter-final yesterday. With the victory, Satwik and Chirag reached the semi-finals of the China Masters for the fourth consecutive time.On the other hand their Malaysian opponents, Azriyn Ayub and Tan Wee Kiong, pulled off a major upset by defeating Indonesia’s world No. 7 pair, Sabar Karyaman Gutama and Moh Reza Pahlevi Isfahani, 21-17, 16-21, 21-19.The victory earned them their first-ever Super 750 semi-final appearance.Meanwhile, India’s campaign in the singles events came to an end as Kidambi Srikanth lost to Hong Kong’s Lee Cheuk Yiu in the Men’s Singles quarter-final. In Women’s Singles, Tanvi Sharma went down against Japan’s Tomoka Miyazaki.

. The External Affairs Ministry today stated that the Indian forensic team in Kathmandu has made significant progress in its work, processing more than 1400 DNA samples so far. It said that the team has generated 378 DNA profiles till now.Meanwhile, the joint technical team from India sustained its dewatering and slush removal activities at the tunnel in Chilime today. However, the slope of the tunnel and constrained access continue to pose challenges despite the use of innovative methods by the team. MEA said that construction of the makeshift path for inducting heavy machinery for clearing the tunnel is also moving forward and expected to be complete in another 2-3 days.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will share his thoughts with the people of the country and abroad in the Mann Ki Baat programme on Akashvani at 11 AM on Sunday. It will be the 137th episode of the monthly radio programme. The programme will be broadcast across the entire Akashvani and Doordarshan network, the AIR News website, and the Newsonair mobile app. It will also be live-streamed on the YouTube channels of AIR News, DD News, the PMO, and the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. Akashvani will broadcast the programme in regional languages immediately after the Hindi broadcast.

. Benchmark domestic equity indices ended in negative territory for second consecutive day. The Sensex declined 555 points or 0.73 per cent to close at 75,578, while the Nifty shed 144 points or 0.61 per cent to settle at 23,635. However, in the broader market at the National Stock Exchange, the Midcap 100 and the Smallcap 100 indices gained 0.2 per cent each.Earlier, the markets opened lower and remained under pressure throughout the session as Brent crude prices edged closer to the 100 US dollar per-barrel mark, heightening concerns over inflation and broader economic uncertainty.In the Sensex pack, 21 out of 30 companies registered losses. Among the top laggards, ICICI Bank lost two per cent, Axis Bank declined 1.7 per cent, and UltraTech Cement dropped 1.2 per cent. In contrast, Bharat Electronics Limited rose one and a half per cent, Adani Ports gained 1.1 per cent and Hindustan Unilever added 0.8 per cent.In the sectoral indices on the BSE, 14 out of 28 sectors edged downward. Among the top underperformers, Insurance as well as Top 10 Banks fell one per cent, Private Banks Index dropped 0.9 per cent and Financial Services lost 0.8 per cent. In contrast, Capital Goods advanced 1.3 per cent, Power gained 0.7 per cent and Healthcare as well as Industrials added 0.6 per cent.The overall market breadth at the BSE was negative, as shares of 2384 companies declined, 2009 advanced and 216 remained unchanged.

. The Archaeological Survey of India has notified Gollala Gudi Temple at Palampet in the Mulugu district of Telangana as a monument of national importance. The Ministry of culture said that the temple is situated near the UNESCO listed Ramappa Temple and is renowned for its exquisite carvings and architectural heritage.The temple is a Trikutalaya and consists of a mandapa facing East and surrounded by three garbhagriha.A monument of national importance in the country is protected under the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1958. The Archaeological Survey of India takes charge of such sites for conservation, maintenance, and regulated public access

. Union Home Minister Amit Shah today paid tribute to the pioneer of modern Hindi literature, Bharatendu Harishchandra, on his birth anniversary. In a social media post, Mr Shah said that Bharatendu Harishchandra infused novelty into emotion, language, and style, thereby giving Hindi its modern form.The Minister added that in his works, one clearly sees the consciousness of social reform alongside devotion to God, advocacy for women’s education and inspiration for independence. Mr Shah said that Bharatendu Harishchandra regarded the mother tongue not merely as a medium of communication but as the foundation of national self-respect and awareness.

. Canada has imposed retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on more than 600 US goods, escalating the trade dispute between two neighbours. The tariffs targeting US merchandise officially came into force last night.Canadian commercial enterprises are operating under the federal government’s newly implemented dollar-for-dollar tariffs, covering approximately 28 billion US dollars’ worth of American imports. The measures, which took effect at midnight, impose tariffs ranging from 15%  to 50% on more than 600 US products. The affected goods include industrial materials such as steel and aluminium, household essentials such as toilet paper, and specialised products such as coin-operated arcade machines.Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump has ordered federal agencies to stop purchasing Canadian products through the government’s primary procurement catalogue until Ottawa provides American businesses and farmers with equal access to the Canadian market. The directive instructs the General Services Administration (GSA) and the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) to immediately begin removing Canadian products from federal procurement channels.In a social media post, Trump accused Canada of unfair trade practices, alleging that Canadian federal and provincial governments prevent American small businesses from selling to public-sector entities while Canadian companies enjoy relatively open access to US  government contracts.

. The government has extended the last date for submission of applications by selected meritorious students for National Means cum Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) for 2026-27 to 30th September this year. The NMMSS is implemented through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Following the extension, the last date for Level-1 verification at the Institute Nodal Officer is 15th October while the last date for Level-2 verification with the District Nodal Officer is 31st October.The National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme awards scholarships to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to prevent drop-out of students after elementary level that is Class eight and encourage them to complete their school education up to higher secondary level that is Class 12. The scholarship amount is 12 thousand rupees per annum per student.The Scheme provides one lakh fresh scholarships every year for Class 9 students who clear the qualifying exam for the scholarship conducted by the State and UT governments. The scholarship is continued through renewal mode from Classes 10 to 12 based on the student’s academic performance. The scheme is applicable only to students studying in State Government, Government-aided and local body schools.The eligibility parameters for availing the scholarship include parental income of not more than 3.50 lakh rupees per annum, a minimum of 55 per cent marks or equivalent grade in the Class 8 examination for appearing in the selection test for award of scholarship. The government has advised all the eligible students to complete their scholarship applications on the National Scholarship Portal within the extended timeline.

. The Indian contingent for the Asian Games 2026  received a grand send-off in New Delhi yesterday in the presence of Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya. Dr. Mandaviya, along with Indian Olympic Association President P T Usha, Sports Secretary Hari Ranjan Rao, and Chef de Mission Sahdev Yadav, unveiled the official jersey of the Indian contingent in the presence of athletes and support staff.Addressing the gathering, Dr. Mandaviya urged Indian athletes to turn pressure into performance, view opponents as opportunities and transform those opportunities into achievements. Highlighting Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s vision for Indian sports, he said the Government has created new pathways for athletes to compete and excel at the global level.Dr Mandaviya also highlighted the growing depth of Indian sport and the emergence of young talent. He said that out of the 503-member contingent, more than three hundred athletes are first-time participants at the Asian Games. Applauding India’s performance at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow, the Union Minister said at the last Commonwealth Games, India won 13 gold medals and this time the tally has improved by more than 35 per cent. He said the target is to establish India firmly on the world sporting stage by 2036, when the country aims to host the Olympic Games. He added that this ten-year plan includes an allocation of more than 36 thousand crore rupees for improving sports infrastructure.The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports informed us that the Asian Games 2026 will be held in Japan, where the Indian contingent will compete across multiple sporting disciplines. The 503-member contingent includes athletes and support staff, with more than three hundred athletes set to make their debut at the Asian Games, reflecting the growing depth and bench strength of Indian sport.

. Chief of the Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan will be on an official visit to Australia and New Zealand beginning today. During the visit, Admiral Swaminathan will hold bilateral discussions with the senior leadership of the Royal Australian Navy and engage with senior Australian defence leadership. He will also visit key operational and training establishments and interact with personnel of the Royal New Zealand Navy and officers undergoing professional military education.In New Zealand, the Chief of the Naval Staff will hold discussions with the senior leadership of the RNZN and engage with senior New Zealand defence leadership. The engagements will focus on further strengthening operational interaction, information sharing, training and professional exchanges between the two navies.
. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold was 0.2 per cent up at 1,53,077 rupees per 10 grams. Meanwhile, Silver rose 0.9 per cent to 2,33,826 rupees per kilogram.

. India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Bihar, East Madhya Pradesh, East Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, West Bengal and North Eastern parts of the country during the next two days. IMD said that thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds are likely to prevail over Andhra Pradesh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Bihar, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Odisha, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim tomorrow. Meanwhile, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Mahe are expected to experience hot and humid weather till 8th of this month.

. Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal today called for India to build on its position as the pharmacy of the world and emerge as a global medical and healthcare destination. Addressing the inauguration of Pharma Mach Tech and Labnext Expo 2026 in New Delhi, Mr Goyal highlighted the growing importance of healthcare beyond treatment, encompassing prevention, wellness, caregiving, medical devices, telemedicine, teleconsultation, innovation and research and development for newer drugs and modern equipment. The Minister also urged the industry to utilise the opportunities arising from India’s free trade agreements. Mr Goyal called upon stakeholders to participate in the country’s development journey and work towards ensuring access to quality education, healthcare and opportunities for all. He said that the medical and pharmaceutical machinery, consumables and related sectors represent a growing field with significant potential to create crores of jobs, thousands of business opportunities and lakhs of new startups, particularly in the medtech field.The Minister also called for strengthening the startup incubation ecosystem for medtech, medical equipment and consumables, along with improvements in design, copyrights, patent laws and the intellectual property ecosystem. Emphasising the need for self-reliance in research, medicines and medical equipment, Mr Goyal called for technology partnerships, stronger buyer-seller relationships and joint ventures to advance self-reliance in the sector. The Minister said India should aim not only to provide high-quality healthcare to every Indian but also to provide wellness and healthcare services to the world from India.

. The Publications Division of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has received seven awards at the Federation of Indian Publishers (FIP) Awards for Excellence in Book Production, 2026. The Division’s journals, books and reference publications in Hindi, English and Urdu have been recognised in various categories.Director General, Publications Division, Dr. Dhiraj Kakadia said that the books and journals published by the Division play an important role in bringing diverse and valuable content related to national development, literature, culture, art and contemporary issues to readers. He said, the seven awards received by the Publications Division are a testament to the collective hard work, dedication and excellence of its officers and personnel.

. Indian para archers will be in the hunt for multiple medals at the World Archery Para Series in Ahmedabad today, as they compete in several gold and bronze medal matches across different events.In the Para recurve mixed team Gold medal match, India’s Bhawna and Harvinder Singh will take on China’s Liang Qiurong and Xia Lei in the final. India’s Sheetal Devi will have another opportunity to claim gold when she faces Aizada Seidan of Kazakhstan in the Para Compound Women’s individual final.Sheetal Devi will also be in action in the Para Compound mixed team Bronze medal match, pairing with Toman Kumar against Iraq’s Sarah Al-Hameed and Abbas Kadhim. In the Para Recurve Women’s Bronze medal match, India will be assured of a medal as Rajshri Dhanraj Rathod takes on compatriot Bhawna in an all-Indian contest. India’s Sarita will face China’s Wang Huiting in the Para Compound Women’s Bronze medal match, while Toman Kumar will meet Iraq’s Abbas Kadhim in the Para Compound Men’s Bronze medal match.

. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh has described Indian community in Sri Lanka as a bridge between the two countries, saying they play a crucial role in strengthening friendship between the two nations. Mr Singh, who reached Colombo yesterday on a three-day visit to Sri Lanka, made the remarks while interacting with members of the Indian diaspora.The Defence Minister said that India will always stand firmly with Sri Lanka in times of crisis, underlining that the relationship between the two countries is based on shared history, culture and faith. He said both nations share close cultural and civilisational ties, which have provided a strong foundation for the growth of the bilateral relationship.In his address, Mr Singh highlighted India’s rapid economic transformation, saying the country is among the fastest-growing major economies in the world and contributes more than 16 per cent to global growth. Noting that India’s economy grew at 7.8 per cent in the first quarter of 2026-27 amid global economic challenges, Mr. Singh pointed out that India has concluded trade deals with 38 countries over the last 12 years, including Free Trade Agreements (FTA) with eight major nations.Referring to the India-European Union FTA as the ‘Mother of All Deals’, he said the agreement opens access to the massive EU market and reflects India’s growing diplomatic and economic capabilities. Mr. Singh credited Prime Minister Narendra Modi for the significant rise in India’s global credibility, saying that compared to 12 years ago, the world today listens when India speaks on the international stage.Mr Singh, who is leading a high-level delegation comprising senior officials from the ministries of defence and external affairs, was received at the Bandaranaike International Airport by Sri Lanka’s Deputy Minister of Defence Maj Gen (Retd) Aruna Jayasekara.

In US Open Tennis, Defending women’s singles champion and top seed Aryna Sabalenka has advanced to the semifinals after overcoming sixth seed Linda Nosková of the Czech Republic in a thrilling quarterfinal. Sabalenka prevailed 7-6, 3-6, 7-6 in a tightly contested match last night.In the men’s singles, 11th seed Frances Tiafoe booked his place in the last four after defeating fellow American Alex Michelsen in a five-set thriller. Tiafoe won 5-7, 3-6, 7-5, 6-3, 7-6 in an all-American quarterfinal.In other women’s singles quarterfinals, third seed Jessica Pegula will take on 26th seed Emma Navarro in another all-American clash this morning, while fourth seed Coco Gauff will face fifth seed Mirra Andreeva of Russia today. Second seed Elena Rybakina of Kazakhstan will be up against China’s Qinwen Zheng in the other quarterfinal. In the men’s singles, defending champion Carlos Alcaraz of Spain will take on eighth-seeded American Ben Shelton this morning.

. In US Open Tennis, Defending women’s singles champion and top seed Aryna Sabalenka will take on sixth seed Linda Nosková of Czech Republic in quarterfinal tonight. In  another quarterfinal matches of Men’s Singles, 11th seed Frances Tiafoe will be up against the unseeded Alex Michelsen in the all-American fixture tonight.In other Women’s Singles last-eight matches, third seed Jessica Pegula will face 26th seed Emma Navarro in all-American clash tomorrow morning. American sensation and fourth seed Coco Gauff will face fifth seed Mirra Andreeva of Russia tomorrow night. Second seed Elena Rybakina of Kazakhstan will lock horns with Qinwen Zheng of China tomorrow.Men’s reigning champion Carlos Alcaraz of Spain will face eighth seed American Ben Shelton tomorrow morning.Top seed German Alexander Zverev will lock horns with Botic van de Zandschulp Netherlands tomorrow night.28th seed Belgian Alexander Blockx will meet unseeded Russian Karen Khachanov tomorrow.

. Praising the remarkable achievement of India’s rise in fintech, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said that the country’s Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is the undisputed champion of this success story. Inaugurating the ‘Global Fintech Fest 2026’ in Mumbai, Mr Modi said this is such a massive transformation that whenever fintech is discussed, it will remain incomplete without UPI. Reiterating his core philosophy of technological empowerment, the Prime Minister praised UPI as the ultimate tool for financial inclusion, successfully penetrating areas ignored by traditional banking models.The Prime Minister pointed out that over 24 billion UPI transactions occurred in August alone. Mr Modi said that because of this impact, French President Emmanuel Macron said that UPI is not just a tech story; it is a civilizational story. Highlighting the global expansion of India’s flagship digital payment system, Prime Minister said that UPI is now live in 11 countries, turning what was once unimaginable into an everyday reality for international payments.Outlining the next strategic phase for international digital payments, Mr Modi emphasised the urgent need to integrate UPI with the domestic payment systems of partner countries, mirroring the seamless cross-border connectivity already established with Singapore. He directed stakeholders to actively link financial networks wherever large Indian populations reside or extensive trade occurs. Emphasising the economic benefits for the diaspora, PM Modi pointed out that reducing transaction costs for the world’s largest remittance-sending population is a critical priority. He explained that integrating digital payment systems globally would significantly accelerate the transfer of funds to families back home.

. In Badminton, Indian pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty clinched the men’s doubles title at the China Masters in Shenzhen today. The Indian duo defeated China’s He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu 11-21, 21-13, 21-17 in the summit clash to secured India’s first-ever title at the China Masters.The victory marks the duo’s second title of the season. They had earlier won the Singapore Open Super 750 and finished runners-up at the Thailand Open Super 500. Satwik and Chirag booked their place in the final after defeating Malaysia’s Nur Mohd Azriyn Ayub and Tan Wee Kiong 21-15, 18-21, 21-11 in the semifinals. The Indian duo had finished runners-up at the China Masters in 2023 and 2025 and reached the semifinals in 2024.

. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh arrived in Colombo today on a three-day visit to Sri Lanka, aimed at deepening bilateral defence and maritime cooperation. Mr Singh was warmly welcomed at Bandaranaike International Airport by Sri Lankan Deputy Minister of Defence Aruna Jayasekara and Indian High Commissioner to Sri Lanka Santosh Jha.The Ministry of Defence in a social media post said, Mr Singh received a warm and traditional welcome from the Sri Lankan side, reflecting the close and enduring ties between India and Sri Lanka. During his visit, the Defence Minister will hold talks with the Sri Lanka’s leadership on various issues to further strengthen bilateral ties in mutually beneficial areas, including a strong maritime and defence partnership. He is leading a high-level delegation comprising senior officials from the Ministry of Defence and the Ministry of External Affairs. He will also interact with the Indian diaspora in Colombo during the visit.Earlier in his departure statement, Mr Singh said, he looked forward to a productive engagement with Sri Lankan leadership during his visit to the island nation. He described Sri Lanka as one of the important partners of India under the Neighbourhood First and MAHASAGAR vision.

. India has joined the US-led global partnership to accelerate the development of secure 6G wireless networks. The initiative includes countries such as the United Kingdom, Germany and Japan said the US Department of Commerce in a post on ‘X’ yesterday. It intends to help coordinate governments’ 6G strategies years before the technology is expected to begin replacing 5G networks in the 2030s.US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Minister of State of Commerce Jitin Prasada held discussions on the future of 6G on the sidelines of the G20 Innovation Ministerial in Chapel Hill, North Carolina last week.In July, the US government launched the “Call to Action for 6G Leadership and Security”, backed by 24 other nations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific.The initiative seeks to advance the objectives of President Donald Trump’s ‘Winning the 6G Race’ December 2025 Presidential Memorandum.Prime Minister Narendra Modi released India’s 6G Vision document much earlier on 22nd March, 2023, which envisages the country becoming a frontline contributor in the design, development, and deployment of 6G by 2030.

. Amnesty International has urged Pakistan government to immediately and unconditionally release human rights lawyers Imaan Mazari-Hazir and Hadi Ali Chattha, whose convictions and prolonged imprisonment have raised serious concerns over the misuse of cybercrime laws to silence dissent.In a letter addressed to the Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, Amnesty stated that the two lawyers were arrested on 23rd of January this year, despite having been granted pre-arrest bail two days earlier. The following day, an Islamabad district and sessions court sentenced them to prison terms ranging from 10 to 17 years under provisions of the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA), including sections concerning cyber terrorism, glorification of an offence and allegedly false or fake information.According to Amnesty, the charges were linked primarily to social media posts in which Mazari-Hazir expressed solidarity with Baloch and Pashtun activists and criticised policies of Pakistan’s military. Chattha was also prosecuted for resharing her posts. The rights organisation said, the trial was conducted with unusual haste and that the lawyers were repeatedly denied opportunities to cross-examine witnesses and present evidence, raising significant fair-trial concerns. Amnesty stated that continued delays could amount to a violation of their right to appeal and alleged that procedural obstacles were being used to prolong their detention. It also expressed concern over their worsening health in prison.

. Russia today said it would welcome any peace efforts by India to end the Ukraine conflict, noting that Moscow’s strategy aligns closely with New Delhi’s position for a resolution through dialogue and diplomacy. Addressing media at a virtual briefing in New Delhi this afternoon ahead of the BRICS Summit, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said they know the position of India on the Ukrainian conflict, and to a great extent, it corresponds with their own position because they do want the solution to the Ukraine conflict by peaceful means, and Russia is open for this process.Mr. Peskov said, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin will hold bilateral talks on the sidelines of BRICS Summit. He said, both leaders are expected to discuss issues of mutual interest. Mr Peskov added that that it will also be an opportunity for President Putin to inform Prime Minister Modi about the situation on the war with Ukraine. He said both leaders are in close personal contact and very pragmatic in their relationship. He said both leaders are able to discuss sensitive matters in open and constructive ways.Replying to a question on trade imbalance netween India and Russia, the Kremlin spokesman said Indian side has raised the issue of trade deficit with Russian side. He further stated that in order to address this imbalance, Russian businesses and companies are now looking for additional goods that can be purchased from India and joint projects that could be launched in India.On import of Russian energy by India, Mr Peskov stated that a new record is set every month but refused to give exact figures. He called sanctions against countries trading with Russia as unacceptable and illegal. He emphasised that it is illegal to attempt to introduce limitations on international trade and to threaten other countries and third parties for doing trade with others.Replying to another query, Mr Peskov maintained that BRICS is against no one. He said BRICS is for participating countries, and for their national interests. He said cooperation in BRICS is based on mutual trust, mutual respect, mutual benefits and trade. He added that these ideals are shared by all the member states.The Kremlin spokesman said that AI would be high on the agenda during the BRICS Summit. He said Russia considers India to be very important partner in the global majority.

. Vultures are extremely important for our ecosystem. By feeding on dead animals, they help keep the environment clean and reduce the spread of harmful diseases.However, vulture populations have declined significantly because of habitat loss, poisoning, and certain veterinary medicines that are harmful to them. Conservation efforts are therefore essential to protect these birds and maintain the balance of nature.On this International Vulture Day, government and environmental experts have urged people to understand, protect, and conserve vultures for a healthier environment.
